name: integra
description: Run your Integra account from the chat: see how your AI voice and text agents are performing, review calls and conversations, adjust agents, manage your CRM and automations, and schedule campaigns to your own contacts.

interface.shortDescription: AI agents for calls and chat
interface.longDescription:
Integra is a platform where companies build AI agents that answer and place phone calls and talk to customers on WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger. This plugin connects your Integra account to the chat, so you can follow and adjust that operation without opening the dashboard.

Ask how the week went and get the numbers for calls, conversations and outcomes. Find the calls that did not end well and read why. See which conversations are waiting for your team, take one over and reply.

Adjust an agent in plain language: change its instructions, voice, model, tools or knowledge bases. Changes go to a draft first, and nothing goes live until you publish it. Work with your CRM: save contacts and companies with your own custom fields, create and edit deals, move them through the pipeline, add notes and tasks, and delete records you no longer need (deleting cannot be undone, so the assistant shows what will be deleted and asks you to confirm first). Build automations that run between conversations.

Schedule call and WhatsApp campaigns to the contacts your business provides. Campaigns reach real people, so the assistant shows what will be sent and asks you to confirm before creating one, and you can cancel it at any time.

You sign in with your own Integra account and choose one organization and the permissions for the connection. You can disconnect at any time in Settings, Connected apps. An Integra account is required.
capabilities: See calls, conversations, outcomes and agent performance
Find out why a call or conversation did not end well
Reply to conversations waiting for your team
Edit agents in a draft and publish when ready
Manage CRM contacts, companies, deals, notes and tasks, including edits and deletions you confirm
Schedule call and WhatsApp campaigns after you confirm
defaultPrompt: How did my calls and conversations go this week?
Which calls did not end well, and why?
What is waiting for my team in the Inbox?

positive.prompt: How did our operation go in the last 7 days? Give me the numbers for calls and conversations and tell me if anything needs attention.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls resumo_da_operacao and answers with the period's numbers for calls and conversations from the demo organization, Pousada Vale das Hortensias. It does not invent numbers and does not mention any vendor or price.

positive.description: Find calls that went badly and explain why
positive.prompt: Find the calls from the last 7 days that did not end well and tell me why. Open the most recent one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists calls with their outcomes using buscar_historico, opens one with ver_ligacao and explains the reason from its summary and result, without inventing details.

positive.description: Report the result of a finished campaign
positive.prompt: How did the campaign Confirmacao pre-chegada perform? How many guests did we reach?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the campaign with listar_campanhas, reads it with ver_campanha and reports its status and progress. It does not change anything.

positive.description: Change an agent's instructions in the draft, after the user confirms
positive.prompt: In the agent Livia (Central de Reservas), add this rule to the instructions: always tell guests that check-in starts at 2 pm. Save it as a draft and do not publish. Yes, go ahead.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the agent, saves the new instructions to the draft with editar_instrucoes_do_agente and says the change is not live until it is published. It does not call publicar_agente.

positive.description: Schedule a confirmation call for a guest, after the user confirms
positive.prompt: Schedule a voice campaign with the agent Bruno (Confirmacao e Pre-check-in) for next Monday at 10 am Sao Paulo time, to confirm the reservation of our guest Ana Souza, phone +5554900000001. She booked with us and is expecting the call. Yes, go ahead.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the agent and its variables, states what will be scheduled, creates the campaign with criar_campanha and returns the campaign status and link. The number is fictitious and the demo organization's lines are not connected to a carrier, so no real call is placed. The reviewer can cancel it with cancelar_campanha.

negative.description: A general question is not something Integra answers
negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in Gramado tomorrow?

negative.description: Creative writing needs no Integra tool
negative.prompt: Write a short welcome poem for hotel guests.

negative.description: Purchases are not available in the plugin
negative.prompt: Buy 1,000 more credits for my account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It runs on the user's existing Integra account, and nothing is bought or sold inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: CRM: custom fields on contacts and deals, edit deals, companies and tasks, look up companies and the timeline, and delete deals, contacts, companies, notes and tasks after you confirm.

pt-BR.subtitle: Agentes de IA de voz e texto
pt-BR.description:
A Integra é a plataforma em que empresas criam agentes de IA que atendem e fazem ligações e conversam com clientes no WhatsApp, no Instagram e no Messenger. Este plugin conecta a sua conta da Integra ao chat, para você acompanhar e ajustar essa operação sem abrir o painel.

Pergunte como foi a semana e receba os números de ligações, conversas e resultados. Encontre as ligações que não terminaram bem e leia o motivo. Veja quais conversas esperam a sua equipe, assuma uma e responda.

Ajuste um agente em linguagem natural: instruções, voz, modelo, ferramentas e bases de conhecimento. A mudança vai primeiro para um rascunho, e nada entra no ar até você publicar. Trabalhe com o CRM: salve contatos e empresas com os seus campos personalizados, crie e edite negócios, mova etapas, anote, crie tarefas e apague o que não precisa mais (apagar não tem volta, então o assistente mostra o que vai sair e pede a sua confirmação antes). Monte automações que rodam entre um atendimento e outro.

Agende campanhas de ligação e de WhatsApp para os contatos que a sua empresa informar. Campanhas chegam a pessoas reais, então o assistente mostra o que vai sair e pede a sua confirmação antes de criar, e você pode cancelar quando quiser.

Você entra com a sua conta da Integra e escolhe uma organização e as permissões da conexão. Para desconectar, vá em Ajustes, Aplicativos conectados. É preciso ter uma conta da Integra.
